covpp.coverage_planning.coverage_pp_base module

Base class for coverage path planning algorithms.

This module defines the abstract interface that all coverage planning methods must implement, enabling a plugin-based architecture.

class CoveragePathPlannerBase(cell: PCell, zmd: ZoneMapData)

Bases: object

Abstract base class for cell-level coverage path planning algorithms.

All coverage planning implementations must inherit from this class and implement the coverage_planning() method. This design allows easy addition of new planning methods without modifying the core pipeline.

Process:

  1. Initialize with a processed cell and zone map data.

  2. Implement coverage_planning() to generate a complete coverage path.

  3. Ensure paths are valid and within cell boundaries.

  4. Final validation of generated paths.

Parameters:

  • cell (PCell) -- Processed cell to plan coverage path for.

  • zmd (ZoneMapData) -- Zone map data object.

cell

Target cell for path planning.

Type:

PCell

zmd

Type:

ZoneMapData

path_m

Generated path in meters.

Type:

MyPath

path_px

Generated path in pixels.

Type:

MyPath

Result:

Sets path_m and path_px attributes for the cell.

run() → None

Execute coverage path planning for the cell.

coverage_planning() → None

Generate coverage path for the cell.

This method must be implemented by all child classes. It should generate a complete coverage path for the cell and populate the path_px and path_m attributes.

The implementation should:

  1. Generate path in pixels (path_px)

  2. Convert to meters using create_path_m()

  3. Handle any cell-specific constraints

filter_path_by_distance() → None

Filter the generated path based on minimum and maximum waypoint distances.

make_path_points_free() → None

Ensure all points in the path are in free space.

evaluate_path_edges() → None

Make sure all path edges are in free space. If not, reconnect them by finding path in the map.

validate_paths() → bool

Validate generated paths for the cell.

covpp.coverage_planning.coverage_pp_hl module

Coverage path planning handler module for managing cell-level path generation.

This module implements the Handler pattern to dynamically load and execute different coverage planning algorithms based on configuration.

class CoveragePPHandler(zone_map_data: ZoneMapData)

Bases: object

High-level interface for coverage path planning across all zone cells.

This handler dynamically loads the appropriate coverage planning algorithm based on pipeline configuration and applies it to all cells in the zone.

Parameters:

zone_map_data (ZoneMapData) -- Zone map data object.

zmd

Zone map data object.

Type:

ZoneMapData

cells

List of cells to plan paths for.

Type:

list[PCell]

all_cell_covp_planners

List of planner instances for each cell.

Type:

list[CoveragePathPlannerBase]

Result:

After planning, path_m and path_px are set for each cell.

Supported Methods:

  • "boust": Boustrophedon (back-and-forth) coverage

  • "contour": Contour-following coverage

  • Custom methods can be added by extending CoveragePathPlannerBase

run(cells: list[PCell])

Execute coverage path planning for all cells.

Parameters:

cells -- List of processed cells from segmentation.

run_covpp_method() → None

Apply coverage path planning algorithm to all cells in the zone.

This method loads the configured planning algorithm and creates a planner instance for each cell. Successfully planned paths are stored in the cell objects (path_m and path_px attributes).
